app.title: Bite Club
app.tagline: Night is falling. Who will you trust?

home.soloHint: No network — just to see the flow.

lobby.title: Village Square
lobby.waitingHost: Waiting for the host to start…
lobby.hostDeviceHint: A computer or tablet is recommended for the host; the game pauses if the screen turns off.
lobby.botHint: Bots act randomly at night and vote at random. For testing.

role.title: Your role
role.waitingOthers: Others are still reading their roles…

night.title: Night {{count}}
night.seerPrompt: Whose identity do you want to learn?
night.doctorRepeatBlocked: You cannot protect the same person two nights in a row.
night.lordPrompt: Who do you turn into a vampire?
night.mistPrompt: Bring the fog? The seer and detective stay blind tonight.
night.detectivePrompt: Whose night do you want to look into?

day.title: Day {{count}}
day.hint: Talk, accuse, defend. Voting starts when the timer ends.
day.spellCastBanner: A spell was cast today: nobody will hang.

ghost.banner: You are a ghost: you see everything, but you do not speak.

settings.title: Settings
settings.ttsHint: Read aloud by the device itself. Turn it on for the host if you are in the same room.

error.hostLostHint: The host disconnected, so the game ended.
error.p2pHint: If you are on mobile data, try switching to WiFi.
error.duplicateSession: This device is already in the room; reconnecting with a new identity…

connect.slow: This is taking longer than expected.
connect.stunFail: Could not discover external address — the network may block WebRTC.
connect.turnOff: No TURN configured. Connections may fail on mobile carrier networks (CGNAT).
connect.hintNoRelay: Could not reach any signalling server; the network may be blocking this traffic.
connect.hintNat: Signalling is up but the devices cannot find each other. This usually means carrier NAT (CGNAT) — try switching to WiFi.
connect.title: Connection
connect.hintRelayDown: Cannot reach the server. Your internet may be down, or the network may be blocking this connection; run the test below.
connect.hintRoomEmpty: Connected to the server, but the host is not in this room. Compare the room code character by character, and make sure the host's app is open on screen (leaving the app on a phone can close the room).
connect.probeSiteOk: Internet works, the site is reachable.
connect.probeSiteFail: Cannot reach the site — you are offline. (The page may have opened from cache, which is why the game loads but will not connect.)
connect.probeBlocked: Internet works but the game connection is blocked: an ad/content blocker, VPN, corporate or family filter. Try WiFi first; if nothing changes, turn the blockers off.
connect.probeAllOk: This device is fine. If the problem persists, run the same test on the other device.
connect.probeSocketSlow: The server connection did not open within 8 seconds (very slow network, or silently dropped).
connect.probeSseOk: But an HTTP stream gets through: the block is WebSocket-specific. Send me this screen — the game can connect over HTTP on this device.
connect.probeSseFail: HTTP streaming is blocked too: this network allows no long-lived connections. You need to switch to WiFi.

test.title: Test tool
test.hint: Force your own role. Only visible with ?test=1; hidden in normal games.

hotseat.passHint: Hand the phone to the next player. Nobody else should look — tap when you are ready.
hotseat.title: Pass and play
hotseat.subtitle: One phone, take turns
hotseat.hint: Everyone takes the same phone in turn: see your role, make your night move, pass it on.

back.title: Leave the game?
back.body: If you are the host, the game ends for everyone in the room.
